The strategies — what holds in every mode
S — the simulation, ONE per node, ONE writer (the sim thread) · A — the presentation's world, windowed only, the same object for life · R — one GDB replica per tick for off-frame readers · SoD
S→A: a MASK per consumer — tables for the map / 3-D / overlays (≈1.3 ms), panel ROWS for the selected units; the inspector reads rows only (the whole-world copy, ≈13 ms, rejected) · S→R: full, ≈1 ms
SimHost / 6 ms CGF · a copy is taken only when someone reads it
ONE short lock on A (the sync vs the UI's world work) · none inside the tick — parallel loops write through per-batch command buffers · R and the gizmo frame are published / leased, never locked
share what is immutable or swapped in one write (terrain, geo, navmesh ✔; TKB, behaviour registry → swap the inside) · copy small values (time, traces) · rebuild derived maps (NetworkEntityMap 0.76
ms) · lease native memory (roads ✔) · publish immutable views (cluster cache 0.01 ms, clock status)
selection, menus, order form, effects live in A (outside the mask) · the UI changes S only by COMMANDS (drag = a ghost in A, the drop = a command) · UI work leaves the tick FIRST (S-1: 26 tool
